theme-background.png.usage: User approved embedded default theme-preview wallpaper
theme-background.png.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: neutral desktop wallpaper for demonstrating SnowDesktop UI themes and real frosted-glass transparency, square 1024x1024. Create a refined minimal abstract wallpaper with broad softly flowing layered curves, a restrained slate-blue, muted blue-gray and warm light-gray palette, medium overall brightness. Subtle soft directional lighting and smooth tonal gradients with a few clean gently curved transitions so blur can be demonstrated. The central area should have tasteful medium-scale variation rather than a flat color, while remaining calm enough for interface controls; no dominant focal object. Balanced composition that works behind both light and dark UI, polished contemporary desktop wallpaper, seamless edge-to-edge image. No UI panels, no glass rectangles, no frames, no border, no icons, no text, no logo, no watermark, no neon, no busy fine patterns.
